subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/page_alloc: refactor build_node_zonelist() out of build_zonelists()

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch refactors the build_zonelists() function in the Linux kernel's page allocation module to extract a new function, build_node_zonelist(), which constructs per-node fallback lists from candidate nodemasks. This change allows for building new zonelists from these nodemasks instead of just using the default N_MEMORY node state list. The patch does not introduce any functional changes and maintains the same behavior as before.
